decisions: IHasRowVersion lives in Infrastructure.Persistence (not Domain): aggregates implementing it need a reference to Infrastructure; ask orchestrator if it should move to Domain.
Task 4.3 interceptor should call OutboxMessageFactory.Create(event, subject) and add it to the context; stream/EventName are read from the event's const fields.
Publisher takes plain DbContext (DI must map DbContext to the service context); EfEventCheckpointStore.SaveAsync only stages, the unit of work commits.
ReportFailureCommand returns ICommand<bool> (true on success) because BuildingBlocks has no Unit type.
Handlers are plain classes without DI registration; Hub/composition must register them (or use AddCommandHandlers) and the IEventStore.
Handlers also validate stream/streams non-empty, offsets >= 0, max >= 1; error text is truncated to 2000 chars.
Services must call services.AddApiJsonConventions() and app.UseCorrelationId() explicitly; they are not wired automatically.
ToHttpResult on a successful Result returns 204 NoContent; on Result<T> returns 200 Ok(value). ProblemDetails title is the ErrorType name.
IEndpointModule implementations need a public parameterless constructor (Activator.CreateInstance).
Future services are added by appending assembly names to ArchitectureAssemblies.AssemblyNames; the layer, isolation, setter, enum and naming rules pick them up by suffix.
Snapshot comparison is semantic (JsonNode.DeepEquals), so formatting differences in the .approved.json files do not fail the test.
